case.summary: A card-not-present fraud alert was triggered for customer C04570’s card C04570-K1 on 2016-11-11, involving a $100.09 online transaction (ID 3450629) with a model risk score of 0.57. The customer denied the purchase and still possessed the card. Similar fraud cases (CC-0286, CC-1796, CC-0262) involved online purchases totaling $300.16, $300.17, and $300.09, respectively, all confirmed fraudulent. The card was blocked, and a case was created. Exposure across related transactions reached $300.14.
